died.name: Lady Jane Grey
died.desc: de facto Queen of England and Ireland
died.cause: quoting Jesus prior to her beheading
died.last_words: Lord, into Thy hands I commend my spirit.

died.name: Ethan Allen
died.cause: on being told the angels were waiting for him
died.last_words: Waiting, are they? Waiting, are they? Well, God damn 'em, let 'em wait!

died.name: Immanuel Kant
died.last_words: I have not yet lost my feeling for humanity.

died.name: Friedrich Schleiermacher
died.desc: German Reformed theologian, philosopher and biblical scholar
died.last_words: Now I can hold out here no longer. Lay me in a different posture.

died.name: Hans von Bülow
died.cause: in response to being asked how he felt

died.name: Richhpal Ram
died.desc: VC, Indian recipient of the Victoria Cross

died.name: Sal Mineo
died.last_words: Oh God! No! Help! Someone help!

born.name: Cotton Mather
born.desc: New England Puritan minister and author
born.cause: His wife wiped his eyes with her handkerchief as he said the last words, alluding to Revelation 21:4
born.last_words: Is this dying? Is this all? Is this all that I feared when I prayed against a hard death? Oh! I can bear this! I can bear it! I can bear it! I am going where all tears will be wiped from my eyes.

born.name: Edward Sugden, 1st Baron St Leonards
born.last_words: This is the happiest day I have ever experienced on earth. I shall soon be where the wicked cease from troubling and the weary are at rest.

born.name: Abraham Lincoln
born.cause: assuring his wife Mary that their friend Clara would not mind them holding hands, shortly before he was fatally shot from behind
born.last_words: She won't think anything about it.

born.name: Charles Darwin
born.last_words: I am not in the least afraid to die.

born.name: Anna Pavlova
born.desc: Russian prima ballerina, creator of the role of The Dying Swan

born.name: Julius Streicher
born.desc: Nazi politician, founder and publisher of Der Stürmer
born.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
born.last_words: Heil Hitler, this is my Purim Fest in 1946! I am going to God. The Bolsheviks will hang you one day!

born.name: Chris McCandless
born.cause: final note written before dying of starvation
born.last_words: I HAVE HAD A HAPPY LIFE AND THANK THE LORD. GOODBYE AND MAY GOD BLESS ALL!
